h1: The 5 Best Monitor Privacy Screens of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best Monitor Privacy Screens: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: five monitor privacy screens in 24 and 27 inch sizes, compared on magnetic mounting, 2-pack value and blue-light filtering.
summary: The 2 Pack 24 Inch Magnetic privacy screen is our top pick for anyone who flips between private and shared screen use. The Peslv 2-pack is the straightforward 24 inch choice, the 27 inch 2-pack adds blue-light filtering, and the single SightPro and generic 24 inch filters cover buyers who only need one.
intro: The most common privacy screen mistake is ordering the wrong size. A filter has to match your monitor's diagonal and its 16:9 shape, and a near miss leaves visible gaps at the edge that defeat the whole point.

We reviewed desktop monitor filters in 24 and 27 inch sizes and set aside the laptop models. They are ranked on how they attach, whether they come as a pair, what extras the listing mentions and which price bucket they land in.

products.name: 2 Pack 24 Inch Magnetic Computer Privacy Screen for Monitor, 16:9 Aspect Ratio
products.verdict: Magnetic attachment makes it easy to switch between private and shared use.
products.description:
Two 24 inch widescreen filters arrive in this set, and they attach with magnets. Two filters come in the box and the set falls in the $50 to $100 range.

Magnetic mounting is the feature that puts it on top. Where the other filters here stay stuck on, this one comes off when a colleague needs to see your screen, which suits anyone who alternates between private and shared work.

Buy it if you swap often or run two monitors. The caveat is price, since it is among the two priciest sets here.
products.idealFor: People who switch between private and shared screen use.
products.skipIf: You never need to remove it.

products.name: Peslv [2-Pack] 24 Inch Privacy Screen for Computer Monitor, 16:9 Aspect Ratio
products.verdict: A removable 24 inch pair with true side-angle privacy.
products.description:
The Peslv ships two 24 inch widescreen filters that are removable. It sits in the $50 to $100 range.

It lands just behind the magnetic set because removable here is not the same as magnetic. It still lets you take the filter off, and it is a clear pick for dual-monitor owners who want a matching pair.

Choose it for a straightforward pair. The caveat is that the listing gives little detail on how it attaches.

products.name: [2 Pack] 27 Inch Computer Monitor Privacy Screen, Blue Light Filter
products.verdict: The only 27 inch option here, with blue-light filtering built in.
products.description:
This is a 2-pack of 27 inch, 16:9 privacy screens that also filter blue light. It is in the $25 to $50 range.

It is the only 27 inch pick in the roundup, which settles the order for anyone with a bigger monitor. Blue-light filtering is a bonus, though the 24 inch sets above it are better on attachment.

It suits 27 inch owners. The caveat is that the listing does not describe the attachment method.

products.name: SightPro 24 Inch 16:9 Computer Privacy Screen Filter for Monitor
products.verdict: A single 24 inch filter that adds anti-glare to side-angle privacy.
products.description:
The SightPro 24 Inch filter is a single 16:9 unit that offers true side-angle privacy plus anti-glare. It is in the $25 to $50 range.

It comes fourth because it is one filter rather than a pair, but anti-glare is a feature none of the other picks list. That tradeoff is the point of buying it.

It suits single-monitor desks. The caveat is that you buy one filter only.
products.idealFor: Single 24 inch monitors in bright rooms.

products.name: Computer Privacy Screen Filter for 24 Inch 16:9 Aspect Ratio Monitor
products.verdict: A no-frills single 24 inch filter for first-time buyers.
products.description:
This is a single 24 inch, 16:9 privacy filter with true side-angle privacy, in the $25 to $50 range.

It finishes the list because it gives you the filter and nothing more. It is a fair way to test whether a privacy filter suits you before committing to a pair.

It suits first-time buyers. The caveat is that it has no extras and no brand reputation to lean on.

whatMatters.detail: Filters are cut to a diagonal and aspect ratio. A mismatch leaves gaps or covers the bezel. Check your monitor's size and 16:9 ratio against the title.
Magnetic filters come off in seconds, while permanent ones stay put. Choose by how often you share your screen. Look for the word magnetic or removable.
A 2-pack covers two monitors, which saves money on dual setups. A single covers one. Count your screens before buying.
Anti-glare reduces reflections in bright rooms. Only the SightPro lists it here. Check for the word if your desk faces a window.
Some filters also tint blue light. The 27 inch pack lists it. Treat it as a bonus, not a reason to buy alone.

faq.q: Will it fit a curved monitor?
faq.a: The listings for these models do not mention curved screens. Check the product page before buying for a curved display.

faq.q: What is the biggest mistake buyers make?
faq.a: Ordering the wrong size. Match the diagonal and the 16:9 ratio exactly.

faq.q: Is a magnetic filter worth it?
faq.a: If you share your screen often, yes. Otherwise a fixed filter does the same job for less.
Follow the listing instructions. The magnetic pair attaches magnetically; for the others the listings do not describe the method.

faq.q: Does it affect how my screen looks?
faq.a: Privacy filters can darken the view, which is the trade for side-angle privacy. The listings do not quantify it.
Only if you have two monitors. A single filter is enough for one screen.

finalTake: The 2 Pack 24 Inch Magnetic privacy screen is the best choice for most office desks. The Peslv is the straightforward pair, and the 27 inch pack is the one if you have a bigger monitor. Get the size right first and the rest is preference.
